ingrid: @mae-auditor auditor flagged a gap: chain-of-custody for RBAC rolebinding changes during the incident. need to produce correlated RBAC change + KMS rewrap evidence. where should i pull from?

mae-auditor: Map to SOC 2 CC6.1 / ISO 27001 A.9 please. auditor needs: timestamp, change ticket id, approver, before/after state, and KMS re-encrypt/rotate proof for the data encryption keys.

sam-security: We can correlate three sources: app-level auth-service audit (writes to splunk), k8s audit logs (cluster-audit), and CloudTrail KMS events. I'll prepare an export slice. quick splunk query I use:
```
index=auth_service source="auth-audit" user=ingrid action=bind_role OR action=unbind_role | table _time user action object request_id approver
```

jordan-devops: For KMS, filter CloudTrail for ReEncrypt and GenerateDataKey events. sample:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=ReEncrypt --start-time 2024-03-10 --end-time 2024-03-13 --query "Events[?contains(Resources[*].ResourceName, 'alias/redwood-prod-kek')]"
```
that will show DEK rewraps triggered by rotation or manual rewrap.

auditbot: Evidence export queued. s3://redwood-compliance/exports/1718234567-rbac-kms-evidence.tar.gz (pre-signed link: https://s3.redwood.example/exports/1718234567-rbac-kms-evidence.tar.gz?exp=72h) :lock:

mae-auditor: Need explicit proof the rolebinding change followed change control. include ticket id and approval record (who clicked approve).

ingrid: Change ticket CHG-2024-9876 — approved by @cto_jane on 2024-03-12T09:02:14Z. Jira link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CHG-2024-9876. Approval recorded in Jira workflow and captured in the ticket history export.

sam-security: Pasted a short excerpt from the k8s audit and auth-service logs for the specific request_id (req-8a3c):
```
2024-03-12T09:01:58Z  ingrid  bind_role  namespace=prod  role=svc-searcher  request_id=req-8a3c  before_roles=[svc-reader]  after_roles=[svc-reader,svc-searcher]  approver=cto_jane
2024-03-12T09:02:20Z  system:controller  rolebinding/patch  request_id=req-8a3c  k8s_audit_id=aa4f...  status=Success
```
This is included in the export (auth-audit-slice.csv).

jordan-devops: Uploaded CloudTrail snippet showing ReEncrypt for DEK tied to request_id=req-8a3c:
```
{ "eventTime": "2024-03-12T09:03:05Z", "eventName": "ReEncrypt", "userIdentity": {"arn":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/ops-rekey"}, "resources": [{"ARN":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01"}], "requestParameters": {"sourceEncryptionContext":"req=req-8a3c"} }
```

mae-auditor: Good. We also require a hash manifest for chain-of-custody plus signs. please provide SHA256 of exported archive and a PGP signature (auditor public key on file).

auditbot: Manifest created at s3://redwood-compliance/exports/1718234567/manifest.txt. SHA256: 3b4f2d9e8a1c6f9d2b7e5c4a9f0d6c8b2a1e4f9c6b7d5a1c3e2f7b8a9c0d1e2f
PGP signature: s3://redwood-compliance/exports/1718234567/manifest.txt.sig

ingrid: I confirmed exports include: Jira ticket PDF, auth-audit-slice.csv, k8s-audit-slice.json, cloudtrail-kms-events.json, manifest.txt, and SHA256 checksums. package uploaded and ACL restricted to auditor org. link above is pre-signed for 72h.

mae-auditor: This satisfies the fieldwork request for now. we'll mark this as evidence for CC6.1/A.9. If we need deeper telemetry (packet capture or forensics) we'll reach back out. thanks team :thumbsup:

sam-security: leaving a short runbook note: when correlating RBAC+KMS for audits, use request_id and change ticket as the join keys. saved in /docs/compliance/runbooks/rbac-kms-correlation.md

ingrid: Thanks all, closing the thread unless the auditor asks for additional items. :white_check_mark:
